items.label: YOUR NEW FAVORITE WATER BOTTLE
items.value: The best travel tumbler out there! Designed for easy use, our HydroJug Traveler features an ambidextrous lid, a circular flip straw and a comfortable grip handle. It's your go-to for various settings like hiking, school, work, gym, car cup holder, or throw in your bag.

items.label: STURDY & LEAK PROOF
items.value: Engineered with a non-slip rubber base and made from top-quality materials, this water bottle ensures both durability and a leak resistant experience.

items.label: STYLISH & FUNCTIONAL
items.value: More than just a water bottle, the HydroJug Traveler complements an active lifestyle. Available in multiple attractive colors, each sip becomes both a delight and a statement.

items.label: EASY TO CLEAN
items.value: This tumbler cup is dishwasher safe and comes with a detachable straw for thorough cleaning, allowing you to maintain hygiene without extra effort.

items.label: HOURS OF TEMPERATURE CONTROL
items.value: With triple-wall stainless steel insulation, your beverage stays perfectly hot or cold for hours, offering consistent freshness wherever you go.
